name: Squat to Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until thighs are parallel.
Drive up explosively, pressing the dumbbells overhead as you stand.
Lower the weights to your shoulders. A thruster — full-body power and conditioning.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: Squat to Press (Dumbbell) is an intermediate lower-body exercise that builds the quadriceps, usually performed with dumbbells. It trains the deep knee-and-hip bend you use every time you sit, stand, or climb stairs.
